question: 如果一个12人的团队，其中有6个身高1.3米的儿童，2个身高1.8米的成人，4个本科在读大学生，他们参观黄姚古镇，总共需要花费多少钱？

steps.description: Read the number of adults from the question text
Locate and read the full adult ticket price from the ticket information in the image
Multiply the number of adults by the full ticket price to calculate adult ticket cost
Read the number of children from the question text
Read the number of students from the question text
Locate and read the half-price ticket price from the ticket information in the image
Multiply the number of children and students by the half ticket price to calculate their total cost
Add the adult ticket cost and children/student ticket cost to get the total expense
